title: Plugin manifest, version 1
description: manifest.json of a plugin of Progressive Web Office (PLUG-009), also an app of DigitalSignalix screens: a content pack or sandboxed code, the hosts it runs on (targets), its settings, the data it reads and its permissions. Unknown properties are allowed for forward compatibility: a host ignores what it does not know.

id.description: Identifier, unique within a registry: lowercase letters and digits, words joined by '-'. A host mirroring several registries names a plugin 'registry/id'.

description.description: One sentence on what it does.

locales.description: Name and description in other languages, by BCP 47 language tag.

license.description: SPDX licence expression, e.g. 'MIT' or 'Apache-2.0 OR MIT'.

kind.description: 'pack': content without code (templates, symbols, snippets…), listed in 'contents'; 'code': a page run in a sandboxed iframe, given by 'entry'.

targets.description: Hosts it runs on: 'pwo' (Progressive Web Office), 'signage' (DigitalSignalix screens). A host installs only plugins naming it, and ignores the targets it does not know.

engines.description: Host versions it works with, as SemVer ranges, by target.

entry.description: Code plugin: its HTML page, a path relative to the plugin.

contents.description: Content pack: its files by kind, paths relative to the pack (a file, a folder ending with '/', or a list of them).

api.description: Code plugin: the major version of the message protocol it speaks (plugin-message-1.schema.json for version 1).

settings.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of its settings: the host draws the form, keeps the values and hands them over.

data.description: The data files it reads, by name.

mediaTypes.description: Media types it accepts, e.g. text/csv, application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet.

table.description: Handed over as a table (columns and rows) rather than bytes.

path.description: A path relative to the plugin, with '/' between folders, never going up.

permissions.description: What it may do, asked when it is installed, shown in the settings and revocable. A permission a host does not know is not granted.

network.description: Hosts it may reach, always through its host (the 'fetch' message), never directly.

document.description: PWO only: the open document, not at all, read, or read and changed.

ui.description: PWO only: places in the interface, e.g. 'panel', 'command'.
